title: Add 1 to a Number Represented as Linked List
description:
A number N is represented in Linked List such that each digit corresponds to a node in linked list. You need to add 1 to it and return the head of modified list.

Input Format:
First line: n (digit count)
Second line: n space-separated digits

Output Format:
Space-separated result digits

python.footer:
def main():
    raw = sys.stdin.read().strip()
    if not raw:
        return
    lines = [l.strip() for l in raw.split('\n') if l.strip()]
    if len(lines) < 2:
        return
    n = int(lines[0])
    vals = [int(x) for x in lines[1].split()]
    dummy = Node(0)
    curr = dummy
    for v in vals:
        curr.next = Node(v)
        curr = curr.next
    sol = Solution() if 'Solution' in globals() else None
    fn = sol.addOne if sol and hasattr(sol, 'addOne') else globals().get('addOne')
    res = fn(dummy.next)
    out = []
    while res:
        out.append(str(res.data))
        res = res.next
    print(' '.join(out))

if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
